Hakai Institute Nereocystis weight data

Source: R/data.R
data_weight_hakai_nereo.Rd

Diameters and wet weights of plants harvested by the Hakai Institute in British Columbia after day of year 140, measured at the maximum sub-bulb diameter, one row per plant.

Usage

data_weight_hakai_nereo

Format

A tibble with 1184 rows and columns:

diameter_mm

Maximum sub-bulb diameter (mm).

weight_kg

Wet weight (kg).

site

Site code, a factor (28 levels).

year

Harvest year, a factor (7 levels, 2019 to 2025).

Source

Hakai Institute, Nereocystis kelp canopy productivity, version 1.3.0, https://doi.org/10.21966/d1s2-s530.

Attribution
